logline: A burned-out government records officer who found proof of bases beneath the ice is hunted through the Stargate archives, the Rogan-sphere, and a dying remote-viewer's last coordinates — until she learns the observer effect isn't metaphor: when the chakras resonate, reality edits itself.
market: Men Who Stare at Goats × The X-Files × Joe Rogan as epistemology — conspiracy as feature, not bug
